chunk_text: VectorPrism dense core powers Stage 1 HNSW candidate retrieval.
Causal scoring uses an asymmetric matrix to rank ordered events.
Hyperbolic embeddings place taxonomy children near their parents.
Relational channel learns subject relation object structure with TransE.
Identity anchor distance helps gate out-of-domain chunks.
Epistemic truth should stay soft until calibration ECE is low.
Changing model version requires versioned corpus re-ingestion.
Recall at 10 and MRR measure whether retrieval quality improved.
pgvector and Qdrant backends store the 1024d tensor payloads.
Stage 2 z-score normalizes channel scores before intent weighting.
